reason: A debugging plugin focused on locating bug causes through code, data-flow boundary, and Git commit bisection, including curl, logging, shell scripts, and git bisect workflows.

summaries.zh: 通过代码、数据流边界和 Git 提交二分法，帮助定位难以确定的缺陷根因。
summaries.en: Helps locate difficult bug root causes through code, data-flow boundary, and Git commit bisection.

capabilities: Guides code bisection by disabling subsets of code
Guides data-flow boundary checks using curl, logs, and direct service validation
Guides automated commit bisection with git bisect run and shell-based judgment scripts
May direct local code, repository, and command-line changes during debugging
